description: This file defines the implementation of a broadcast channel consumer extension in Orleans, including interfaces, classes, and methods for handling stream subscriptions, errors, and published items.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelConsumerExtension
classes.description: Implements the broadcast channel consumer extension, managing stream subscriptions and callbacks.

classes.name: Callback<T>
classes.description: A generic callback handler for published items and errors, supporting type-specific processing.

classes.name: ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback handlers used internally within the extension.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles error notifications for a specific stream.

methods.name: OnPublished
methods.description: Handles published item notifications for a specific stream.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a callback for a specific stream ID.

methods.name: GetStreamCallback
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a callback handler for a given stream ID.

methods.name: BroadcastChannelConsumerExtension
methods.description: Constructor initializing the extension with grain context accessor.
